snapshot.text: Split system of the Ministry of Public Health and the social security institute IPS, with recurring medicine shortages. A new health minister took office in September 2026; Paraguay also turned against the new WHO pandemic instrument.

minister.name: Isaías Fretes
minister.role: Minister of Public Health and Social Welfare

priorities.title: Health improvements in 60 days
priorities.text: The government promised visible improvements in health within 60 days.

priorities.title: Medicine procurement
priorities.text: Changes to medicine purchasing to avoid shortages.

priorities.title: Position on WHO
priorities.text: Paraguay now rejects the new WHO instrument for future pandemics, having earlier supported it.
